name: @role-orchestrator/approval
description: M4-01 risk grading + one-shot approvals. Every action is graded from its declared effect dimensions (readonly/write/network/delete/external-side-effect/main-branch-delivery) plus permission increments and capability-gate state: high risk (permission elevation, broad network, irreversible delete, external side effects, main-branch delivery, explicit-authorization argv patterns, unverified/unknown capabilities) MUST hold an approval first; forbidden argv patterns (--dangerously-* family) are refused outright with no v1 authorization path. actionDigest is a pure sha256 over a canonical serialization of the COMPLETE action essentials (full argv array, target repo+baseSha+targetSha, cwd, profile revision, derived permission-increment set, dimensions, write scope, required capabilities) - any element change yields a different digest (A17). The approval lifecycle is PENDING -> APPROVED -> CONSUMED with guarded CAS transitions, idempotency-key creation that replays the SAME row (A18), expires_at guards so expired approvals are never consumable, and single consumption enforced by a guarded UPDATE (exactly one winner under concurrency). Unattended writes map to the capability-gate node-checkpoint control (A19): approvals bind a precise action BEFORE execution; no mid-run pause is faked.
